## MANTLE / RUNTIME ROUTING — unchanged, carried forward (see bedrock-mantle-coverage-gap memory)
2026-08-19 Anthropic Messages samples repointed to bedrock-runtime `/anthropic`; OPENAI_BASE_URL on
  49 non-Anthropic model cards moved from bedrock-mantle `/v1` to bedrock-runtime `/openai/v1`.
2026-08-15 Endpoint guidance now RECOMMENDS bedrock-runtime for new apps, including for OpenAI- and
  Anthropic-compatible workloads. bedrock-mantle remains fully supported.
  >>> RULE: SELECT PARSERS BY ROUTE PATH, NOT HOSTNAME. Both endpoints serve both API shapes.
      Mantle-only surfaces remain: Web Search, PROJECTS, WORKSPACES, Chat Completions on mantle,
      the mantle Responses API page.
2026-08-14 AgentCore Memory integration for Bedrock agentic retrieval — `memoryConfiguration` on
  AgenticRetrieveStream can restore an earlier session from short-term memory and/or let the agent
  retrieve from long-term memory.
2026-08-11 IAM principal cost allocation on bedrock-mantle.
2026-07-30 Bedrock Agents Classic no longer open to new customers.

Updated: 2026-09-02.
